description.value: A BC government-operated retail liquor store on Highway 97 in the Okanagan & Thompson corridor, stocking wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders. It is one of 198 BCLIQUOR locations province-wide and accepts empty container returns for deposit refunds. Touring cyclists passing through on BC-97 may stop to purchase beverages, but no cyclist-specific services are documented for this location.
